One platform for all finance decisions.

Reporting stays connected across spend, AP and procurement, so you can make decisions without switching tools.

Startups and enterprises alike trust Ramp for reporting.

Ask. Refine. Decide. Instantly.

Ask Ramp any question about spend, procurement, AP, or budgets. Get an answer you can drill into, share, and act on.

Day-one clarity. No setup, no report-building.

Where is spend trending? Who are our top vendors? Which teams are over budget? Pre-built dashboards for the questions finance teams ask every single week.

Turn data into a conversation. Then into your own dashboard.

Every chart is clickable. Drill from a spike to the exact transactions, ask Ramp follow-ups as you go, and build views that match how your company actually runs.

Share the insight where decisions happen.

Send dashboards to stakeholders and schedule exports so reporting runs on a cadence — not on reminders.

Track your budget in Ramp.

Budgets is tightly integrated across Ramp — so every insight drives action, and execution finally maps back to plan.

Learn more about Ramp Budgets

Track budgets vs. actuals in real time.

Empower your team with live budget tracking across every card swipe, bill paid, and PO committed.

Stop approving spend you'll regret.

Every approval shows what's left, what's committed, and all the context you need to make the right call.

No more back-and-forth with budget owners.

Give teams their own dashboards and approval authority. "How much of my budget is left?" gets answered instantly.
